title: Weather forecast alarms
note: Built in PR #36 (open). Held until after the first public release.
details: Pick the weather, any number of reminders (alarm or soft) and when: any time, or before your alarms and calendar events, with quiet hours. Settings, Weather reminders. Android re-checks the forecast in the background every few hours; texts in all 20 languages. Quiet on Shabbat and festivals.
